content.overview: This topic maps the principal operative sections of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 used in examination and practice: definitions (s. 2), Central powers (s. 3), officers (s. 4), directions (s. 5), pollution rules (s. 6), emission standards (s. 7), hazardous substances (s. 8), entry/inspection (s. 10), sampling (s. 11), penalty (s. 15), cognizance (s. 19), delegation (s. 23), effect of other laws (s. 24) and general rule-making (s. 25). Use this map to route facts to the correct section before deep analysis.
content.glance: Ask: (1) Definition issue → s. 2? (2) Power/direction → ss. 3–5? (3) Duty breach → ss. 7–8? (4) Inspection/sample → ss. 10–11? (5) Penalty/cognizance → ss. 15, 19? (6) Machinery → ss. 23–25?
content.study:
Do not treat this overview as a substitute for section-specific topics. Always open the individual section file for full ingredients.

No new case invented.

sections.heading: Definitions and powers
sections.body: s. 2 definitions; s. 3 Central measures; s. 4 officers; s. 5 directions; s. 6 rules for s. 3 matters.

sections.heading: Substantive duties
sections.body: s. 7 emission/discharge standards; s. 8 hazardous substance handling.

sections.heading: Investigation
sections.body: s. 10 entry and inspection; s. 11 sampling procedure.

sections.heading: Penalty and cognizance
sections.body: s. 15 penalty; s. 19 cognizance routes (official complaint or 60-day private notice).

sections.heading: Machinery and supremacy
sections.body: s. 23 delegation (with exceptions); s. 24 effect of other laws; s. 25 general rule-making (non-delegable).

examples.title: Routing a pollution fact pattern
examples.body: Excess emission → s. 2 pollutant definition → s. 7 duty → s. 10/11 evidence → s. 5 direction and/or s. 15 penalty → s. 19 cognizance.

hypotheticals.question: Where do you start an EPA problem question?
hypotheticals.analysis: Identify the medium and the alleged breach; map to definition (s. 2), duty (ss. 7–8), evidence (ss. 10–11), direction (s. 5) and penalty/cognizance (ss. 15, 19).

distinctions.title: Section map vs section-specific topic
distinctions.right: Full ingredients, exam structures and misconceptions in each section file.

misconceptions.trap: Memorising only s. 15 is enough for EPA questions.
misconceptions.correction: Penalty rests on prior duty, evidence and cognizance sections; the full map is required.
